# NoFluff Front Desk

Pay-per-booking front desk for home-service trades in Celina, Prosper, McKinney, Frisco, Anna, Melissa, Little Elm, Aubrey and Denton, TX.

## Offer
- $0 setup
- $49 a month
- $29 per confirmed booking
- $499 a month cap for every trade, roofing and water and fire restoration included
- Bookings past the cap are free
- No contract
- Cancel anytime, effective at the end of the current billing month
- 48 hours to dispute a booking
- 5 pilot spots
